title: rondeletia neriifolia subsp. calcicola
intro: Rondeletia neriifolia subsp. calcicola, commonly known as the calcicolous rondeletia, is a plant species within the Rubiaceae family, native to the Caribbean region. This plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, digestive issues, and respiratory problems, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Rondeletia neriifolia subsp. calcicola include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which contribute to its medicinal uses. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
